exactText: my comment made in early 2020 that “cash is trash”
normalizedClaim: Cash (low-yielding) is a poor investment relative to other assets amid expected money printing and low rates in early 2020.
resolutionCriteria: Real returns on cash (interest rates minus CPI inflation) remaining negative or near-zero through 2021-2022 while risk assets (stocks, gold) outperformed, per Federal Reserve and BLS data.

resolution.explanation: Cash yields were near zero while inflation rose sharply and risk assets recovered strongly after the 2020 crash, validating the relative underperformance of cash.

evidence.sourceTitle: Federal Reserve interest rate data and BLS CPI
